Alger, 16 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 16, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The High Commission for Digitization has formalized the addition of twenty new online administrative services to the Dzair Digital Services portal. Developed with the Ministry of Tourism and Craft Industry, these e-services aim to digitize the procedures for users and professionals in the sector.
Le Haut-Commissariat à la numérisation a: The High Commission for Digitization has announced the integration of twenty additional online services on the national government portal Dzair Digital Services. This initiative, carried out in partnership with the Ministry of Tourism and Craft Industry, responds to the directives of the President of the Republic, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, regarding the expansion of access to digital public services.
Ces démarches dématérialisées couvrent t: These digitized procedures cover three major aspects of the sector: the management of tourism activities, specialized education, and the supervision of craft trades. The stated objective of the authorities remains the simplification of administrative procedures and bringing state services closer to citizens and economic operators.
Des démarches ciblant le secteur tourist: Procedures targeting the tourism and craft sector
Dans le domaine du tourisme et de l'hôte: In the field of tourism and hospitality, the platform now allows users to submit requests for opening travel agencies, classifying hotel and catering structures, or obtaining authorizations for thermal establishments. The site also centralizes the issuance of licenses for guides and the monitoring of investment projects.
En matière de formation, les usagers peu: Regarding training, users can consult competition notices, check admission criteria, and register for bachelor's and master's degree courses provided by the National Higher School of Tourism (ENST). Technician and higher technician training offers proposed by the national institutes of Tizi Ouzou and Bou Saâda are also accessible there.
Enfin, le volet consacré aux artisans en: Finally, the section dedicated to artisans encompasses all formalities for registration, modification of information, deregistration from the professional register, as well as the renewal or obtaining of duplicate artisan cards. Professionals can carry out their qualification procedures to obtain the status of artisan or master artisan, register for apprenticeship programs, participate in national competitions and awards, register trademarks, and ensure the electronic tracking of their requests.
Le portail national Dzair Digital Servic: The national portal Dzair Digital Services now integrates 20 new digital services dedicated to the tourism and craft sector.
Le Haut-Commissariat à la numérisation a: The High Commission for Digitization led this initiative jointly with the Ministry of Tourism and Craft Industry.
Les nouvelles prestations concernent l'i: The new services concern hotel investment, licenses, university training, and procedures related to craft registers.
